instruction: How to create a basic sssd.conf for LDAP
output:
<think>
Alright, we need to create a basic sssd.conf for LDAP.
For this, cat is the right tool — cat operations.
A quick sanity check afterward saves debugging time later.
</think>
cat > /etc/sssd/sssd.conf << 'EOF'
[sssd]
domains = example.com
config_file_version = 2
services = nss, pam

[domain/example.com]
id_provider = ldap
auth_provider = ldap
ldap_uri = ldap://ldap.example.com
ldap_search_base = dc=example,dc=com
EOF
